aec_challenge_source_gain_provenance.corpus: pinned ICASSP2022 complete no-movement pure-far set

established: Measured room/wall configuration changes alone can alter integrated RIR transfer energy by several dB even when source, array and microphone geometry are fixed.
The pinned ICASSP2022 pure-far corpus exhibits a much broader approximately 28.42 dB P05-to-P95 source-domain mic/render energy-ratio dispersion across cases.

The AEC-Challenge source-domain ratio is strongly associated with public DTD false activation, while prior diagnostics rejected resampling, Sync interpolation/selection, HPF, route delay/coherence and incoherent excess as sufficient primary explanations.
not_established: The 3.47 dB dEchorate span and the 28.42 dB AEC-Challenge span are from different datasets and measurement definitions and must not be subtracted to estimate a device-gain contribution.
dEchorate does not provide the same playback/reference-to-captured-microphone device chain as the AEC-Challenge recordings.
The physical split between room acoustics, playback/record gain, device DSP, nonlinearities and other source-domain factors remains unidentified for AEC-Challenge.
synthesis.decision_boundary: Room acoustics are now evidenced as a material contributor to transfer-magnitude variation, but the available cross-source evidence is insufficient to authorize gain normalization, a DTD threshold change, a detector semantic change, or a source candidate.
synthesis.next_discriminative_requirement: A controlled or labeled dataset that jointly observes playback/reference level, captured microphone level, room/RIR ground truth and device/gain-chain state under matched conditions.

prohibited: treating cross-dataset dB spans as directly decomposable components
